headline: Ukraine drone strike hits deep inside Russia
standfirst: Kyiv is targeting industrial infrastructure far from the front lines.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A Ukrainian drone strike on an industrial city in Russia killed at least 13 people.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Kyiv has been launching long-range strikes against targets hundreds of miles past the border.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These attacks aim to damage the Russian economy by hitting its oil refinery infrastructure.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Whether Ukraine expands these long-range operations to further disrupt Russian industry.

caption:
A Ukrainian drone strike on an oil refinery deep inside Russia has resulted in at least 13 deaths.

This attack marks a significant escalation in Kyiv's strategy to disrupt the Russian economy. By targeting industrial hubs far from the front lines, Ukraine is attempting to weaken the resources supporting the war effort.
